notes: Selected instances to minimize extraneous variables. ARM and x86 have identical specs. GPU and FPGA normalized by vCPU.

t4g.small.notes: Matches t3.small exactly (2 vCPU, 2GB RAM) - perfect ARM vs x86 comparison

t3.small.notes: Matches t4g.small exactly (2 vCPU, 2GB RAM) - perfect ARM vs x86 comparison

g4dn.xlarge.notes: Smallest GPU instance. Normalize by vCPU for comparison with ARM/x86. GPU power measured separately.

f1.2xlarge.notes: Smallest FPGA instance. Normalize by vCPU for comparison. Requires Cloud-ZK AFI for ZK workloads.

normalization_strategy.arm_vs_x86: Direct comparison - identical specs (2 vCPU, 2GB RAM)
normalization_strategy.gpu_vs_fpga: Normalize by vCPU - both have different vCPU counts
normalization_strategy.all_instances: Normalize all metrics by vCPU for cross-hardware comparison
confounding_variables: GPU has 4 vCPU vs ARM/x86 2 vCPU - normalize by vCPU
FPGA has 8 vCPU vs ARM/x86 2 vCPU - normalize by vCPU
RAM differs (2GB vs 16GB vs 122GB) - workloads use <1GB to minimize impact
Network differs - not relevant for compute workloads
Instance families differ (burstable vs fixed) - monitor CPU credits
